lines.en: Sssss as it glides through shadows
Night breeze leaves a shadow trail
I follow you, half a step behind.
There is one more shadow at the hall's end.

lines.zh: 我站在镜子里等你回头。
lines.en: I stand in the mirror, waiting for you to look back.
When you turned off the light, I woke.
Can you still count your pills?
I crouch in the shadow at the foot of your bed.
The corners of this room belong to me.
I am counting how many times you turn over.

lines.zh: 眼中闪现凶光，注视玩家
lines.en: Evil glint in eye, stares at player

lines.zh: 我偏着头，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I tilt my head and look you over.

lines.zh: 你眨了一次眼，我近了一格。
lines.en: You blinked once, and I came one block closer.
Do not rub your eyes. It only makes me clearer.
The screen is lit, and so am I.

lines.zh: 我站在你视野的最边上。
lines.en: I stand at the very edge of your sight.
The less you dare to look, the clearer I get.
That was not a hallucination. It was me.

lines.zh: 影子里流出的，不是我的血。
lines.en: What leaks from the shadow isn't my blood.

lines.zh: 身体薄得像纸，快撑不住。
lines.en: My body is thin as paper and failing.

lines.zh: 我只是影子里的一只手。
lines.en: I am only a hand in the shadow.

lines.zh: 影子也会碎，只是不会死。
lines.en: A shadow can shatter — it just won't die.

lines.zh: 黑暗中忽闪着幽光，诱惑你前行。
lines.en: Shimmering in the dark, tempting you forward.

lines.zh: 它轻轻飘过，留下一缕影子。
lines.en: It drifts by, leaving a shadow behind.

lines.zh: 它的双眼在黑暗中闪烁。
lines.en: Its eyes glow in the dark.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的轻柔触碰。

lines.en: It creeps close to you quietly.

lines.zh: 你被它的诡异光芒吸引。
lines.en: You are drawn to its eerie light.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边低语，引诱你。
lines.en: It whispers in your ear, tempting you.
Its form is like a dream.

lines.zh: 它用魅影轻拂你的脸庞。
lines.en: It brushes your face with a shadow.

lines.zh: 你的脚步与它撞了个满怀。

lines.en: A black shadow collides with you.

lines.zh: 你撞到了它柔软的身体。
lines.en: You bump into its soft body.

lines.zh: 它的身影与你擦肩而过。
你撞到了它的虚无躯体。
lines.en: You bump into its ethereal body.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的影子里，凉到脚。
lines.en: You step in my shadow; cold reaches your feet.
Your body makes contact with it.

lines.zh: 你与它的触碰擦出火花。
lines.en: Your touch with it sparks something.

lines.zh: 它的同伴在黑暗中等待。
lines.en: Its mate waits in the dark.
It searches for a mate to fly with.

lines.zh: 它的伴侣在阴影中出现。
lines.en: Its partner emerges from the shadows.

lines.zh: 它们在黑暗中相互依偎。
lines.en: They huddle together in the dark.

lines.zh: 它的灵魂伴侣在远处等待。
lines.en: Its soulmate waits in the distance.

lines.zh: 它的伴侣在月光下等待。
lines.en: Its mate waits under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它们在黑暗中找到了彼此。
lines.en: They find each other in the dark.

lines.zh: 它的影子伴侣在夜幕下出现。
lines.en: Its shadow mate appears under the night.
I have no face and no voice.
This patch of shadow is mine to keep.
Your hands can't reach my soul!
Find my shadow in the dark!
A footstep sounds; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 主人派我来，我已经看见你。
lines.en: My master sent me. I see you now.

lines.zh: 你站在灯下，我就在影子里看你。
lines.en: You stand in the lamp; I watch from the shadow.

lines.zh: 理智碎了，我就能碰到你。
lines.en: When your sanity breaks, I can touch you.
You finally admit that I exist.

lines.zh: 我垂下头，爪子已经抬起。
lines.en: I lower my head; my claws are raised.

lines.zh: 我是影子的第一形态，先来。
lines.en: I'm the shadow's first shape. I go first.

lines.zh: 影子贴着地面，朝你滑过来。
lines.en: My shadow hugs the ground and slides toward you.

lines.zh: 我的手已经能推开空气。
lines.en: My hand can push the air aside now.
The pills will not help you any more.
Your shadow turns around before you do.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就看见我了。
lines.en: I count to three, and you will see me.
There is no one else in this house.

lines.zh: 我把门关上了，从头到尾。
lines.en: I closed the door, all the way.

lines.zh: 你多看了一眼的角落，我在。
lines.en: In the corner you glanced at twice, I am there.
The instant the lamp died, I took shape.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子拉长了一截。
lines.en: I stretched your shadow a little longer.
Those footsteps you heard were mine.

lines.zh: 我从来都在，只是你没看见。
lines.en: I was always here. You simply did not see me.
You left the closet door open tonight.
This shadow of mine is borrowed from you.

lines.zh: 水灌进影子里，我变重了。
lines.en: Water fills my shadow; I grow heavy.
The shadow scatters. It gathers again.

lines.zh: 雷光穿过我，影子散了半边。
lines.en: Lightning pierces me; half my shadow scatters.

lines.zh: 虚空把我薄薄的身体撕开。
lines.en: The void tears my thin body apart.
